title: PRISM-BN: A Controlled Corpus and Benchmark for Text-to-Parameterized Bayesian Network Extraction
abstract: arXiv:2609.21673v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Probabilistic Graphical Models (PGMs), especially Bayesian Networks (BNs), expose directed structure and probabilistic parameters, making them natural symbolic targets for neurosymbolic AI. Yet training text-to-parameterized-BN systems requires paired text-to-BN resources unavailable at scale. We introduce PRISM-BN, a controlled corpus of 5054 BN-grounded descriptions paired with discrete reference BNs containing variables, states, directed edges, root priors, and full multi-parent CPDs across five domains. The instances are derived from 50 Wikipedia-seeded backbones, and their probabilities are internally constructed benchmark targets rather than externally validated causal estimates. PRISM-BN is built with PRISM, a marginal-first pipeline that elicits marginal and local joint distributions, analytically recovers normalized CPDs, and constructs locally reparameterized subgraphs. We define a benchmark with semantic node and state alignme

translated_title: PRISM-BN：用于文本到参数化贝叶斯网络提取的受控语料库与基准
translated_abstract: 概率图模型（PGM），尤其是贝叶斯网络（BN），能够展现有向结构和概率参数，使其成为神经符号人工智能的天然符号目标。然而，训练文本到参数化贝叶斯网络的系统需要成对的文本-贝叶斯网络资源，而这类资源目前无法大规模获取。我们提出了PRISM-BN，这是一个受控语料库，包含5054个基于贝叶斯网络的描述，与涵盖五个领域、包含变量、状态、有向边、根节点先验以及完整多父节点条件概率分布（CPD）的离散参考贝叶斯网络相配对。这些实例源自50个以维基百科为种子的骨干网络，其概率是内部构建的基准目标，而非经过外部验证的因果估计。PRISM-BN通过PRISM构建，PRISM是一个“边缘优先”的流水线，它引出边缘分布和局部联合分布，通过解析方式恢复归一化的条件概率分布，并构建局部重参数化的子图。我们定义了一个包含语义节点和状态对齐的基准（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了PRISM-BN——一个包含5054个文本描述与离散贝叶斯网络配对的受控语料库和基准，通过边缘优先的PRISM流水线构建，用于推动文本到参数化贝叶斯网络提取任务的研究。
